text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — paged-attn allocator OOMs detected on node inference-prod-07 (prod-r1). Pod inference-svc-3 auto-restarted 2x. Trace: https://logs.internal/trace/4912345678 — alert at 2026-02-28T02:14:02Z

sara: I'm on call. seeing KV slab resident page count climbing steadily over last 45m. eviction rate not keeping up with allocations. evidence of fragmentation/slow-creep rather than a single spike.

chris: Any customer-visible impact?

sara: Small but real — Vidify had 3 timeout spikes (5xx) in the last 10m. Overall p95 latency for text-gen on that cluster went from 210ms -> 950ms during the flares. We routed some traffic to prod-r2 as fallback so impact limited.

mike: Good catch. Immediate mitigations we can try:
- enable aggressive KV eviction
- disable kv-prefetch / prewarm to reduce allocations
- restart pods sequentially to pick up flags

jess: +1. Also lower kv_eviction_threshold from 0.8 -> 0.6 temporarily to force earlier churn. We'll monitor hit rate regression.

sara: I'm going to push env flags and restart 1 pod at a time. Running command now:```bash
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/inference RUNTIME_FLAGS=--kv.enable_aggressive_eviction=true,--kv.prefetch=false,--kv.eviction_threshold=0.6
# then rollout restart
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/inference --timeout=10m
```

incident-bot: Runbook note — recommended temporary knobs: kv.enable_aggressive_eviction, kv.slab_defrag=1, kv.prefetch=false. If OOM persists, fall back to draining node and reprovision.

nicole: Do we have a hotfix binary that tweaks allocator defrag behavior?

mike: We have allocator v1.12 which includes a conservative defrag path behind flag --kv.slab_defrag=1. Not deployed in prod by default. We can enable the flag without binary swap for now.

sara: After first pod restart (inference-3a): resident pages dropped ~18%, page-faults down, no OOM in that pod yet. Rolling to next.

chris: Great. Any signs of regression in throughput or accuracy from caching changes?

sara: Minimal. Vidify p50/p95 returned to normal after failover and restarts. Token throughput slightly lower (~3%) on evicted pods — acceptable for now.

mike: Keep a watch for 30–60m. If stable, we'll keep these flags for the next 24h and open a follow-up to implement allocator defrag in head and a safer eviction policy.

jess: I'll create an issue for a proper rollback-safe feature: "KV allocator: adaptive defrag + throttled prefetch" and assign to @nicole.

lucas: Taking second-shift handoff. Recap:
- Problem: slow KV slab fragmentation -> gradual resident page growth -> OOMs
- Mitigation performed: set RUNTIME_FLAGS --kv.enable_aggressive_eviction=true, --kv.prefetch=false, --kv.eviction_threshold=0.6, --kv.slab_defrag=1; sequential rollout restart of inference deployment; traffic fallback to prod-r2 during rollouts.
- Result: OOMs ceased after 3 restarts, memory usage down ~15-20% across nodes, Vidify 5xx spikes mitigated.
- Open actions: create postmortem, run allocator stress test with long-running prefix workload, add canary for kv.slab_defrag on staging, define GTI for eviction threshold tuning.

nicole: Assigned the follow-up issue: https://tracker.internal/issue/RED-2439 "KV allocator: adaptive defrag + throttled prefetch". I'll own the engineering follow-up.

sara: Monitoring window started at 2026-02-28T02:22Z. Will post another update if anything flares. Current status: mitigated, under observation. :white_check_mark:

chris: I'll inform support to update Vidify with a short incident note and that we've mitigated and are doing a follow-up.

lucas: Handoff complete. I'll keep pager on for next 2 hours and will escalate if memory climbs again. Scheduling postmortem meeting for 2026-03-02 16:00Z. Owners: nicole (tech), jess (prod), sara (ops).

incident-bot: Incident state changed to "mitigated" by sara at 2026-02-28T02:25:17Z.

sara: quick log excerpt from restarted pod showing defrag trigger:```
[2026-02-28T02:18:03Z] kv_allocator: slab_defrag=1 triggered for slab=attn_kv,size=64MB,fragments=23
[2026-02-28T02:18:04Z] kv_allocator: reclaimed=12MB,resident=1200MB->1188MB
[2026-02-28T02:20:11Z] runtime: eviction_pass completed, freed=56MB
```

chris: Thanks team. Postmortem and next steps after monitoring window. :pray:
